India and Seychelles Deepen Ties with New Agreements and Credit Line

Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded a visit to Seychelles, marking 50 years of diplomatic relations. The two nations agreed to expand cooperation in defence, digital payments, and space, with India announcing a $175 million development package and a Rs. 1,250 crore credit line. Seychelles also sought advanced light helicopters from India.
